name: Player Balance: Outbound call returns a business error
description: Issue #8: sbo's findAccount() outbound call responds with a non-zero error.id. Sbo::findAccount() throws Exception(error.msg), which PlayerController::balance() catches and turns into a 200 with that message as the body.

queries.name: sbo_wallet
queries.sql: SELECT id, balance, freeze, player_id FROM wallets WHERE platform_id = 3 AND user_id = 1

queries.name: sbo_player
queries.sql: SELECT id, account, vendor_player_id, playing FROM players WHERE station_id = 1 AND platform_id = 3
